name: Hymn of Battle
body:
School enchantment [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, bloodrager 2, cleric/oracle 3, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft..

Effect All allies within 30 ft.
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

With a wave of your hand a distant hum grows louder until an uplifting chorus urges your allies towards victory, all allies within range may make a new save against any effect currently affecting them. While this spell lasts allies continue to be allowed additional saving throws against ongoing effects at the start of your turn.
